subject: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance
body:
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@crestviewhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for jumping on this. Our InfoSec team is evaluating the request we submitted for a tenant-specific log retention variance (30 -> 180 days for debug traces tied to our test accounts). The SIG and SOC reviewers asked for a short evidence bundle they can consume quickly: 1) a high-level attestation of the variance approval workflow, 2) a manifest of sampled log buckets/keys we can inspect, and 3) a redactable copy of the retention policy change delta.

Can Redwood provide a compact evidence pack (PDF + manifest CSV) and an optional attestation paragraph we can include in our procurement signoff? We need this by EOD Wed (30 Jun) to keep our procurement window.

Appreciate it,
Anika Rao
Sr. Security PM — Crestview Health

----

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely produce a compact evidence pack targeted to SIG/SOC reviewers. Plan:
- Ben will assemble the attestation language and the approval trail (ticket + reviewer IDs).
- I'll pull a one-page retention delta and an internal summary of compensating controls for the extra 150 days.
- Marissa will confirm operational access for your reviewers and whether we need redaction before delivery.

We have a few clarifying q's: 1) Do your reviewers require raw log samples or an index/manifest with checksums and truncated snippets? 2) Should the attestation come from Redwood legal or from our Security lead (Ben)?

Targeting a delivery draft by Tue EOD (29 Jun) so you have Wed to review. I’ll include an export manifest (CSV) and a PDF evidence pack.

Best,
Tessa
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance

Tessa — drafting attachments now. Quick notes:
- Evidence pack (evidence_pack_compact_v1.pdf): approval trail (ticket IDs, approvers), summary of why variance was granted (customer business need + mitigations), audit log showing the retention config change.
- Manifest (log-sampling-manifest.csv): list of S3-style object keys (redacted in full), sampling timestamps, SHA256 checksums, and sampling rationale. We will only include truncated snippets (~200 chars) where helpful; full raw logs require a legal request.
- Retention delta (retention-policy-delta.txt): machine-readable diff and the human-friendly one-paragraph summary.

I recommend the attestation be signed by Redwood Security (me) for speed; legal can provide a separate letter if procurement insists.

Attachments: evidence_pack_compact_v1.pdf (stub), log-sampling-manifest.csv (stub), retention-policy-delta.txt (stub)

Ben Carter
Head of Trust & Safety

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@crestviewhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance

Anika — quick operational note: for your external reviewers to inspect the manifest we can either: 1) provide the CSV and a redacted sample bundle delivered via secure share (read-only link, time-limited), or 2) coordinate a short review session (30-45m) where we walk through the manifest and show the sampling keys in a controlled environment. Which is preferable?

If you want the DocuSign attestation in procurement-ready language, I can take Ben's paragraph, add a procurement header, and route it through Legal. That will add ~48 hours. If speed is critical, Ben's security-signed attestation should suffice for SIG/SOC review.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager

----

From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact evidence pack request — Crestview log retention variance

Thanks team — plan below works. Crestview InfoSec prefers option 1 (CSV + redacted sample bundle via secure share) for speed. We will review the compact PDF and manifest; if procurement needs a DocuSign-ready attestation we will request it separately (procurement@crestviewhealth.com).

A couple small asks:
- In the manifest, can you include a column called "review_hint" with a short note on why a particular sample is representative?
- Can the CSV anonymize tenant IDs but preserve sampling timestamps?

If you can get the secure link and pack to us by EOD tomorrow (1 Jul), that will keep our approval on track.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll loop procurement if we need the legal-signed attestation.

— Anika

[Attachment stubs referenced above: evidence_pack_compact_v1.pdf (PDF, 4 pages, redacted), log-sampling-manifest.csv (CSV, 58 rows; tenant ids redacted), retention-policy-delta.txt (TXT, 2 lines)]

[Delivery notes: secure share link and DocuSign draft will be added to this thread when ready. HubSpot deal: CSTV-4921.]
